overview:
This check monitors [KAI Scheduler][1] through the Datadog Agent.

KAI Scheduler is a Kubernetes scheduler for AI and GPU workloads. It schedules pods into hierarchical queues with quotas, fair share, priorities, and preemption. This integration collects metrics from the KAI scheduler and queue-controller to help you monitor queue quotas and allocation, fair share, scheduling latency, and preemption.

[1]: https://github.com/kai-scheduler/KAI-Scheduler
setup:
### Installation

The KAI Scheduler check is included in the [Datadog Agent][2] package.
No additional installation is required on your server.

### Configuration

This integration is part of GPU Monitoring. Enable GPU Monitoring in the configuration of the Agent that runs the check, which is the Cluster Check Runner or node Agent that the cluster check is dispatched to:

```yaml
gpu:
  enabled: true
```

The equivalent environment variable is `DD_GPU_ENABLED=true`. When GPU Monitoring is disabled, the Agent skips every configured KAI Scheduler instance.

KAI Scheduler exposes its metrics from two deployments in the `kai-scheduler` namespace. Each one serves Prometheus metrics over plain HTTP on port `8080`:

- The scheduler, through the `kai-scheduler-<shard>` service (`kai-scheduler-default` for the default shard), serves scheduling cycle, action, preemption, and queue fair share metrics.
- The queue-controller, through the `queue-controller` service, serves queue quota and allocation metrics.

A single instance scrapes any combination of these endpoints. Each metric is tagged with `kai_component` (`scheduler` or `queue_controller`) so that the generic metrics of each component can be told apart.

KAI Scheduler is a cluster-level service. Configure this integration as a Cluster Agent [cluster check][10] so only one Agent instance scrapes the endpoints. For file- or ConfigMap-based configuration, set `cluster_check: true` in the instance:

```yaml
clusterAgent:
  confd:
    kai_scheduler.yaml: |-
      cluster_check: true
      init_config:
      instances:
      - scheduler_endpoint: http://kai-scheduler-default.kai-scheduler.svc:8080/metrics
        queue_controller_endpoint: http://queue-controller.kai-scheduler.svc:8080/metrics
```

If you run several scheduling shards, add one `scheduler_endpoint` instance per shard service.

#### Binder metrics (optional)

The binder, through the `binder` service, binds the pods that the scheduler places. It exposes no KAI-specific metrics, only generic controller-runtime, Go, and process metrics. Its `bindrequest` controller reconcile errors, reconcile latency, and work queue depth show pods that the scheduler placed but that failed to bind, for example because of a GPU sharing reservation or volume error. To collect them, add `binder_endpoint: http://binder.kai-scheduler.svc:8080/metrics` to the instance. These metrics are tagged with `kai_component:binder`.

See the [sample kai_scheduler.d/conf.yaml][4] for all available configuration options.

#### Metrics namespace

The check expects KAI's default metrics namespace, `kai`. Do not change it with the `--metrics-namespace` flag or the `queueController.metricsNamespace` setting. The scheduler also exposes an unprefixed copy of each of its metrics that is never updated, so the check only collects the `kai_`-prefixed names.

### Validation

[Run the Cluster Agent's `clusterchecks` subcommand][11] and look for `kai_scheduler` under the Checks section.

[10]: https://docs.datadoghq.com/containers/cluster_agent/clusterchecks/?tab=helm#configuration-from-configuration-files

metrics.name: kai.action.latency.milliseconds
metrics.description: Duration of the last run of each scheduling action.

metrics.name: kai.action.podgroups.attempted.count
metrics.description: Number of pod groups each scheduling action attempted to schedule.

metrics.name: kai.action.podgroups.scheduled.count
metrics.description: Number of pod groups each scheduling action scheduled.

metrics.name: kai.action.scenarios.filtered.count
metrics.description: Number of scenarios each scheduling action filtered out before simulation.

metrics.name: kai.action.scenarios.simulated.count
metrics.description: Number of scenarios each scheduling action simulated.

metrics.name: kai.certwatcher.read_certificate.count
metrics.description: Number of TLS certificate reads by the controller-runtime certificate watcher.

metrics.name: kai.certwatcher.read_certificate_errors.count
metrics.description: Number of failed TLS certificate reads by the controller-runtime certificate watcher.

metrics.name: kai.controller.runtime.active_workers
metrics.description: Number of reconcile workers currently in use, per controller.

metrics.name: kai.controller.runtime.conversion_webhook_panics.count
metrics.description: Number of panics in the conversion webhook.

metrics.name: kai.controller.runtime.max_concurrent_reconciles
metrics.description: Maximum number of concurrent reconciles allowed, per controller.

metrics.name: kai.controller.runtime.reconcile.count
metrics.description: Number of reconciliations, per controller and result.

metrics.name: kai.controller.runtime.reconcile_errors.count
metrics.description: Number of reconciliations that returned an error, per controller.

metrics.name: kai.controller.runtime.reconcile_panics.count
metrics.description: Number of reconciliations that panicked, per controller.

metrics.name: kai.controller.runtime.reconcile_time.seconds
metrics.description: Distribution of reconciliation durations, per controller.

metrics.name: kai.controller.runtime.reconcile_time.seconds.count
metrics.description: Number of timed reconciliations, per controller.

metrics.name: kai.controller.runtime.reconcile_time.seconds.sum
metrics.description: Total time spent reconciling, per controller.

metrics.name: kai.controller.runtime.reconcile_timeouts.count
metrics.description: Number of reconciliations that timed out, per controller.

metrics.name: kai.controller.runtime.terminal_reconcile_errors.count
metrics.description: Number of reconciliations that returned a terminal error, which is not retried, per controller.

metrics.name: kai.controller.runtime.webhook_latency.seconds
metrics.description: Distribution of admission webhook request latencies, per webhook path.

metrics.name: kai.controller.runtime.webhook_latency.seconds.count
metrics.description: Number of timed admission webhook requests, per webhook path.

metrics.name: kai.controller.runtime.webhook_latency.seconds.sum
metrics.description: Total time spent processing admission webhook requests, per webhook path.

metrics.name: kai.controller.runtime.webhook_panics.count
metrics.description: Number of panics in admission webhooks.

metrics.name: kai.controller.runtime.webhook_requests.count
metrics.description: Number of admission webhook requests, per HTTP status code.

metrics.name: kai.controller.runtime.webhook_requests_in_flight
metrics.description: Number of admission webhook requests currently being served.

metrics.name: kai.evicted_pods.count
metrics.description: Number of pods evicted, by namespace, node pool, and action.

metrics.name: kai.go.gc.duration.seconds.count
metrics.description: The summary count of garbage collection cycles.

metrics.name: kai.go.gc.duration.seconds.quantile
metrics.description: A summary of the pause duration of garbage collection cycles.

metrics.name: kai.go.gc.duration.seconds.sum
metrics.description: The sum of the pause duration of garbage collection cycles.

metrics.name: kai.go.gc.gogc.percent
metrics.description: Heap growth percentage that triggers garbage collection, set by `GOGC`. 100 by default.

metrics.name: kai.go.gc.gomemlimit.bytes
metrics.description: Soft memory limit of the Go runtime, set by `GOMEMLIMIT`. The maximum int64 value when unset.

metrics.name: kai.go.goroutines
metrics.description: Number of goroutines that currently exist.

metrics.name: kai.go.info
metrics.description: Always 1. The `go_version` tag holds the Go version the component was built with.

metrics.name: kai.go.memstats.alloc_bytes
metrics.description: Heap memory allocated to objects and still in use.

metrics.name: kai.go.memstats.alloc_bytes.count
metrics.description: Heap memory allocated since the process started, including memory already freed.

metrics.name: kai.go.memstats.buck_hash.sys_bytes
metrics.description: Memory used by the profiling bucket hash table.

metrics.name: kai.go.memstats.frees.count
metrics.description: Number of heap objects freed.

metrics.name: kai.go.memstats.gc.sys_bytes
metrics.description: Memory used for garbage collection metadata.

metrics.name: kai.go.memstats.heap_alloc.bytes
metrics.description: Heap memory allocated to objects and still in use. Same value as `kai.go.memstats.alloc_bytes`.

metrics.name: kai.go.memstats.heap_idle.bytes
metrics.description: Heap memory not in use, either free or returned to the operating system.

metrics.name: kai.go.memstats.heap_inuse.bytes
metrics.description: Heap memory in use, including space reserved for objects but not yet used.

metrics.name: kai.go.memstats.heap_objects
metrics.description: Number of allocated heap objects, live or not yet swept.

metrics.name: kai.go.memstats.heap_released.bytes
metrics.description: Heap memory returned to the operating system.

metrics.name: kai.go.memstats.heap_sys.bytes
metrics.description: Heap memory obtained from the operating system.

metrics.name: kai.go.memstats.mallocs.count
metrics.description: Number of heap objects allocated.

metrics.name: kai.go.memstats.mcache_inuse.bytes
metrics.description: Memory in use by mcache structures, the per-processor allocation caches.

metrics.name: kai.go.memstats.mcache_sys.bytes
metrics.description: Memory obtained from the operating system for mcache structures.

metrics.name: kai.go.memstats.mspan_inuse.bytes
metrics.description: Memory in use by mspan structures, which track heap spans.

metrics.name: kai.go.memstats.mspan_sys.bytes
metrics.description: Memory obtained from the operating system for mspan structures.

metrics.name: kai.go.memstats.next_gc.bytes
metrics.description: Target heap size of the next garbage collection cycle.

metrics.name: kai.go.memstats.other_sys.bytes
metrics.description: Memory used for other runtime allocations, such as trace buffers and profiling.

metrics.name: kai.go.memstats.stack_inuse.bytes
metrics.description: Memory used by goroutine stacks.

metrics.name: kai.go.memstats.stack_sys.bytes
metrics.description: Memory obtained from the operating system for stacks, including OS thread stacks.

metrics.name: kai.go.memstats.sys.bytes
metrics.description: Total memory obtained from the operating system by the Go runtime.

metrics.name: kai.go.memstats.time_since_last_gc.seconds
metrics.description: Time since the last garbage collection.

metrics.name: kai.go.threads
metrics.description: Number of operating system threads created by the Go runtime.

metrics.name: kai.leader_election.master_status
metrics.description: Whether this replica holds the leader election lease: 1 for the leader, 0 for a standby.

metrics.name: kai.plugin.latency.milliseconds
metrics.description: Duration of the last OnSessionOpen or OnSessionClose call of each scheduler plugin.

metrics.name: kai.preemption.attempts.count
metrics.description: Number of preemption attempts.

metrics.name: kai.process.cpu.seconds.count
metrics.description: User and system CPU time used by the component process.

metrics.name: kai.process.max_fds
metrics.description: Maximum number of file descriptors the component process can open.

metrics.name: kai.process.network_receive.bytes.count
metrics.description: Bytes received over the network by the component process.

metrics.name: kai.process.network_transmit.bytes.count
metrics.description: Bytes sent over the network by the component process.

metrics.name: kai.process.open_fds
metrics.description: Number of file descriptors open by the component process.

metrics.name: kai.process.resident_memory.bytes
metrics.description: Resident memory size of the component process.

metrics.name: kai.process.uptime.seconds
metrics.description: Time since the component process started.

metrics.name: kai.process.virtual_memory.bytes
metrics.description: Virtual memory size of the component process.

metrics.name: kai.process.virtual_memory.max_bytes
metrics.description: Maximum virtual memory available to the component process.

metrics.name: kai.queue.usage.memory
metrics.description: Historical usage of the queue reported by the UsageDB. Units depend on the UsageDB configuration, and the value is 0 without one. Resource: memory.

metrics.name: kai.workqueue.longest_running_processor.seconds

metrics.name: kai.workqueue.queue_duration.seconds

metrics.name: kai.workqueue.queue_duration.seconds.count

metrics.name: kai.workqueue.queue_duration.seconds.sum

metrics.name: kai.workqueue.retries.count
metrics.description: Number of items requeued for a retry, per queue.

metrics.name: kai.workqueue.unfinished_work.seconds

metrics.name: kai.workqueue.work_duration.seconds.sum
